grammar.summary: 本课讲外甥乔治为捡50便士反被卡住的趣事，语法上突出「too...to... 太……而不能……」结果结构、由 which/who 引导的定语从句，以及现在分词作伴随状语（bounced, rolled, pushed 等连续动作）。句中还出现 what is more 递进插入语。

points.title: 定语从句 (Relative Clauses)
points.explanation: 用关系代词 which/who 引导定语从句修饰先行词。本课用 who 修饰 the lady（人），用 which（隐含）修饰 fifty pence piece，使叙事紧凑。最后一句 the lady who owns the sweet shop 即典型人物定语从句。

examples.en: George was not too upset by his experience because the lady who owns the sweet shop heard about his troubles and rewarded him with large box of chocolates.
examples.cn: 此事并没使乔治过于伤心，因为糖果店老板娘听说了他遇到的麻烦后，赏给他一大盒巧克力。

examples.en: Very few of the fifty pence pieces and pound coins I have given him have found their way there.
examples.cn: 我给了不少50便士的硬币，但没有几个存到储蓄罐里。

points.title: 现在分词与连续动作 (Participle/Serial Actions)
points.explanation: 本课用一连串并列动词描写乔治的急切动作：took off, rolled up, pushed，并以 bounced, disappeared 等表示硬币的运动轨迹，强调动作的连贯性。bounced along 与 disappeared down 是硬币掉落时的伴随过程。

examples.en: George took off his jacket, rolled up his sleeves and pushed is right arm through the drain cover.
examples.cn: 乔治脱掉外套，卷起袖子，将右胳膊伸进了阴沟盖。

examples.en: On his way to the sweet shop, he dropped his fifty pence and it bounced along the pavement and then disappeared down a drain.
examples.cn: 在他去糖果店的路上，50便士掉在地上，在人行道上跳了几下，掉进了阴沟里。

points.title: what is more 递进插入语 (Progressive Insertion)
points.explanation: what is more 作插入语，意为「而且；更有甚者」，引出递进的、往往更糟或更出乎意料的信息。本课用它衔接「不但没找到钱，而且胳膊也拔不出来」的窘境。

examples.en: He could not find his fifty pence piece anywhere, and what is more, he could no get his arm out.
examples.cn: 但他摸了半天也没找到那50便士硬币，他的胳膊反倒退不出来了。

exercises.q: ...the lady ______ owns the sweet shop heard about his troubles and rewarded him with large box of chocolates.
He could not find his fifty pence piece anywhere, and ______, he could no get his arm out.
George took off his jacket, rolled up his sleeves and ______ is right arm through the drain cover.（选与课文一致的形式）
用动词的正确形式填空：On his way to the sweet shop, he dropped his fifty pence and it bounced along the pavement and then ______ down a drain.（写出 disappear 的过去式）
